title: "Dr_Cab_AQI_API"
format: html

## Set-up 
```{r}
library(sf)
library(arcgis)
library(mapview)
library(janitor)
library(tidyverse)
library(sysfonts)
library(showtext)
library(tidyverse)
library(RAQSAPI)


# colors 
soe_colors <- c(
  red    = "#DD5A54",
  blush  = "#EDBFB2",
  orange = "#EC940C",
  blue   = "#608ED8",
  olive  = "#737F2E",
  forest = "#283523"
)
soe_palette <- unname(soe_colors)

## add fonts
font_add_google("Fraunces", "Fraunces")
font_add_google("Manrope", "Manrope")
showtext_auto()
showtext_opts(dpi = 300)

# ggplot theme
theme_soe <- function(base_size = 12) {
  theme_minimal(base_size = base_size, base_family = "Manrope") +
    theme(
      text             = element_text(color = soe_colors["forest"]),
      plot.title       = element_text(family = "Fraunces", face = "bold",
                                      size = rel(1.4)),
      plot.subtitle    = element_text(face = "italic", size = rel(1.1)),
      axis.title       = element_text(face = "bold"),
      legend.position  = "bottom",
      panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
      panel.border     = element_rect(color = soe_colors["forest"],
                                      fill = NA, linewidth = 0.6),
      strip.background = element_rect(color = soe_colors["forest"],
                                      fill = NA, linewidth = 0.6),
      strip.text       = element_text(family = "Fraunces", face = "bold",
                                      color = soe_colors["forest"])
    )
}
theme_set(theme_soe())
```

## Set up query 
Note that you'll need to sign up for an account by typing "" into your browser. 
Once you receive confirmation, I suggest following the instructions for the 
`keyring` package in this [tutorial](https://cran.r-project.org/web/packages/RAQSAPI/vignettes/RAQSAPIvignette.html). 

Next, we'll set some information based on the parameters, date, and state we want
annual summaries for. You can see a list of parameters [here](https://aqs.epa.gov/aqsweb/documents/codetables/parameters.html). 

It looks like there isn't any PM2.5 data available for Norfolk County, but there
are observations for NO2 from two monitors, one in Great Blue Hill and another 
in Quincy. 
```{r}
## check monitors in Norfolk (NO2 is still up, PM2.5 was retired in 2014)
temp <- aqs_monitors_by_county(
  parameter  = c("42602", "88101"),
  bdate      = as.Date("20150101", format = "%Y%m%d"),
  edate      = as.Date("20151231", format = "%Y%m%d"),
  stateFIPS  = "25",
  countycode = "021")


norfolk_no2 <- aqs_annualsummary_by_county(
  parameter  = "42602",
  bdate      = as.Date("20150101", format = "%Y%m%d"),
  edate      = as.Date("20251231", format = "%Y%m%d"),
  stateFIPS  = "25",
  countycode = "021"
)

## quick map
norfolk_no2 |> 
  filter(pollutant_standard == "NO2 1-hour 2010") |> 
st_as_sf(coords = c("longitude", "latitude"), crs = 4326) |> mapview()

## Faceted wrap of Average Annual Norfolk NO2 values
norfolk_no2 <- norfolk_no2 |> 
  filter(pollutant_standard == "NO2 1-hour 2010") |>   
  mutate(location = ifelse(site_number == "3003", "Blue Hill Observatory", "Quincy")) |> 
  select(year, location, arithmetic_mean)

norfolk_no2 |> 
  ggplot(aes(x = year, y = arithmetic_mean)) + 
  geom_step() + 
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(2015, 2025, by = 1)) + 
  labs(x = "year", y = "Average Annual No2") + 
  facet_wrap(~location)

```

## Massachusetts averages
```{r}
## pull no2 data
ma_no2 <- aqs_annualsummary_by_state(
  parameter = "42602",
  bdate     = as.Date("20150101", format = "%Y%m%d"),
  edate     = as.Date("20251231", format = "%Y%m%d"),
  stateFIPS = "25")

## pull pm2.5 data
ma_pm25 <- aqs_annualsummary_by_state(
  parameter = "88101",
  bdate     = as.Date("20150101", format = "%Y%m%d"),
  edate     = as.Date("20251231", format = "%Y%m%d"),
  stateFIPS = "25")

## tidy the two dfs a bit more 
ma_no2_tidy <- ma_no2 |> 
  filter(pollutant_standard == "NO2 1-hour 2010") |>  
  group_by(year) |> 
 summarise(arithmetic_mean = mean(arithmetic_mean)) |> 
  mutate(location = "Massachusetts") |> 
    mutate(measure = "NO2 Parts per billion") |> 
   select(year, location, arithmetic_mean, measure)


ma_pm25_tidy <- ma_pm25 |> 
  filter(pollutant_standard == "PM25 Annual 2024") |>  
  group_by(year) |> 
 summarise(arithmetic_mean = mean(arithmetic_mean)) |> 
  mutate(location = "Massachusetts") |> 
  mutate(measure = "PM2.5, Micrograms/cubic meter (LC)") |>
   select(year, location, arithmetic_mean, measure)


joined_df <-ma_no2_tidy |> 
  bind_rows(ma_pm25_tidy)

## plot
joined_df |> 
  ggplot(aes(x = year, y = arithmetic_mean, color = measure)) + 
  geom_step(lwd = 1) + 
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(2015, 2025, by = 1)) + 
  labs(x = "year", y = "Average Annual Measure") + 
  facet_wrap(~measure, scales = "free_y") +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("#EC940C","#608ED8")) 
```
